metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.9 · 1957 · Tammy and the Bachelor
metas.description: An unsophisticated young woman from the Mississippi swamps falls in love with an unconventional southern gentleman.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.5 · 1961 · Tammy Tell Me True
metas.description: A wholesome river girl floats her boat to college and meets a professor who finds her charming.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.0 · 1963 · Tammy and the Doctor
metas.description: A Los Angeles doctor falls for a Mississippi girl working as a nurse's aide in his hospital.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.8 · 1967 · Tammy and the Millionaire
metas.description: A bayou girl (Debbie Watson) and her kin (Frank McGrath, Denver Pyle) have run-ins with some rich folks.
